summary_1line: A king resolves a gift dispute revealing Desire and Wrath’s test, after which Bhishma explains the spiritual destinies of Gayatri reciters.

image_candidates.scene_text: The king stretches out his hand as drops of water fall upon it while the Brahmana offers the fruits of his Gayatri recitation.
Virupa reveals to the king that he and Vikrita are Desire and Wrath who tested him under the watch of Time, Dharma, and Death.
A radiant ascetic rises through realms of fire, sun, wind, and space before dissolving into a boundless luminous Brahman.
